$comment: intEHRgrator example-set catalog. In-repo assets use relative URIs under ../test/fixtures/ (resolved against this file's URL; build copies fixtures into dist/). External targets keep absolute GitHub blob URLs (rewritten to raw.githubusercontent.com). Canonical long-term home may move to ehrtslib.

sets.title: Dummy vitals example (Source: JSON Schema, Target: JSON Schema)
sets.description: Minimal JSON Schema source, two valid instances, and a JSON Schema target. No mapping.

sets.title: Dummy vitals with mapping
sets.description: Same dummy files plus a Blockly mapping (source paths into the JSON Schema target) and a Defaults Map.

sets.title: Dummy vitals example (Source: JSON Schema, Target: OpenEHR Template)
sets.description: Minimal JSON Schema source, two valid instances plus one named-invalid instance, mapped to the simple-diagnose-and-vitals OPT. Blood-pressure Position uses a Decision table. Uses the operational template (.opt), which is self-contained; the sibling .t.json is a differential Archetype Designer file that needs overlay parent ADLs to flatten.

sets.title: Dummy vitals series (JSON Schema with repeating measurements → openEHR)
sets.description: Blood-pressure series schema with a coded ICD-10 diagnosis and repeating measurements. Two valid instances plus one named-invalid instance (diastolic/bodyPosition). Mapping uses a Decision table for diagnosis and a for_each_list over measurements.

sets.title: OBX MHV1, JSON --> openEHR
sets.description: Obstetrix MHV1 JSON Schema and three maternity-care registration instances, targeting the MHV1 Prenatal visit openEHR template. Lifestyle codes use a Decision table. The template is a GitHub .t.json (dependencies fetched from the same branch).

sets.title: Patient-reported chemotherapy symptoms (FLAT → TakeCare XML)
sets.description: openEHR FLAT composition from a patient symptom questionnaire, mapped to TakeCare ProfdocHISMessage XML using schema-generated Target schema blocks (TakeCare-CasenoteWrite-edit01.xsd). Rebuilds Mappningsscript 1.9.1 PROD: all TextKeyWord/NumericKeyword TermIds, the no-symptom 16183 branch, free-text helper, and Defaults Map header parameters. Select Go Template output mode to see generated Go text/template code.

sets.title: Lung MDT form (Handlebars Notes → TakeCare XML)
sets.description: Rebuilds the production lung-MDT Handlebars mapping as Blockly using schema-generated TakeCare ProfdocHISMessage blocks (TakeCare-CasenoteWrite-edit01.xsd), not generic XML blocks. Header fields come from the Defaults Map. Notes keep the original Handlebars. Set TemplateId/TemplateType to the casenote used in the target environment.

sets.title: Medication order data from Cytodos and TC via Karda to openEHR FLAT (Karda JSON -> FLAT)
sets.description: OrdinationRCCV1 JSON Schema (aligned with Avro, including PDL vårdgivare name/HSAID) and seven Kafka-shaped order instances targeting the MedKurdag openEHR OPT. Blockly mapping from the Go text/template artefact uses Decision tables for form/route; TypeScript Conversion Script Test Run is the check.

sets.title: Medication treatment data from Cytodos and TC via Karda to openEHR FLAT (Karda JSON -> FLAT)
sets.description: AdministrationRCCV1 Avro source schema (aligned with JSON Schema, including PDL vårdgivare name/HSAID) and five Kafka-shaped administration instances targeting the PerSubstans openEHR OPT. Blockly mapping from the Go text/template artefact uses a Decision table for ISM states.
